project.name: LangChain4j-CDI Demo 6 - Supervisor Agent
project.description: A2A orchestration demo showing the @RegisterSupervisorAgent pattern: LLM-driven quality loop replacing explicit exit conditions. The supervisor orchestrates style-scorer and style-editor sub-agents until the story reaches a quality score of 0.8. Two outputKey pitfalls to avoid: 1. Do not set outputKey on @RegisterSupervisorAgent — with LAST strategy the supervisor would write the last sub-agent's output (the score) to scope["story"], overwriting the actual story. 2. Do not set outputKey="story" on @RegisterSequenceAgent — the sequence writes its result (the supervisor's return value, again possibly the score) to scope["story"]. Without outputKey on the sequence, style-editor's scope["story"] is preserved intact. Read the story via scope.readState("story", "") and the score via scope.readState("score", 0.0).
